routeSelectionNote: This packet is built for one route and states it: Deferred acceptance dismissal — HRS § 712-1200 three-year route. The source form prints two waiting periods under EXPUNGEMENT OF NON-CONVICTION INFORMATION — one year for a Chapter 853 deferred plea generally, and three years where the dismissed charge is under HRS §712-1200. This family is the three-year §712-1200 route, so the participant is told the three-year figure and is not asked to choose between them. The conviction paragraph and its court-order attachment belong to the other branch of the form and are declared NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE with the route condition named.
